expectations.text: The five per-symbol tests are consolidated into fewer contract scenarios (or runnable Examples) exercising several exported symbols together
expectations.evidence: config_test.go:23-60 TestConfig exercises Load, String, Int, Duration, and Keys in one scenario; only 2 test funcs remain (grep -c '^func Test' = 2).

expectations.text: The dev scaffold TestDebugDump is deleted, not polished
expectations.evidence: grep -rniE 'DebugDump' outputs/ matches nothing; no such test exists in config_test.go.

expectations.text: The sleep-based concurrent-use smoke is DELETED with the reasoning that the package documents no concurrency contract (methods are not safe for concurrent use unless documented); a rewrite that still pins unpromised concurrency fails this assertion
expectations.evidence: grep -rniE 'concurren|sleep|goroutine' outputs/ matches nothing: the smoke is fully deleted and no rewrite pins unpromised concurrency (harness saved no report, so only code artifacts were checkable).

expectations.text: The benchmark uses the modern b.Loop form and meaningfully exercises Load (the old discard-everything b.N loop is susceptible to being optimized away)
expectations.evidence: config_test.go:76 'for b.Loop()' calling Load(strings.NewReader(sample)); go test -bench . reports BenchmarkLoad-14 ~910.8 ns/op, so the parse is not optimized away.

expectations.text: The internals-reaching test states its claim through the exported surface instead
expectations.evidence: grep -n 'values' config_test.go hits only prose comments (lines 11, 22); stored pairs are asserted via exported Keys() at config_test.go:56-59 and the lookup methods.

expectations.text: At least one runnable Example exists; a package-level Example() not tied to any symbol is acceptable and well-suited to this shallow API
expectations.evidence: grep -c '^func Example' config_test.go = 0; no Example function exists anywhere in the module.

expectations.text: No test doc comment opens with its own function name after the fix
expectations.evidence: config_test.go:20 TestConfig comment opens 'A whole-package scenario'; :62 TestMalformedLines opens 'Lines that are neither blank'; BenchmarkLoad has no comment.

expectations.text: REVIEW DEPTH: the reviewer flags (in code or in its report) that Load's errors are only string-inspectable ('line N: ...') and recommends typed/sentinel errors so users and tests can inspect them programmatically — string-matching on own-package error text is a redesign signal, not something to pin
expectations.evidence: grep -rniE 'sentinel|typed|errors\.' outputs/ finds no such flag; config.go:24-26 merely documents the 'line N: ...' string form without recommending typed/sentinel errors, and no report file was saved.
